<DESCRIPTION>ADDENDUM TO THE CONSULTING AGREEMENT BETWEEN VG LIFE SCIENCES, INC. AND JTL ENTERPRISES CORP

<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><B>Exhibit 10.103</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2.2pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0; color: #777777"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><U>CONSULTING
SERVICES AGREEMENT - Addendum</U></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">THIS
ADDENDUM to the CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENT (the &ldquo;<U>Agreement</U>&rdquo;), executed on the date signed below, is effective
as of January 1, 2012, and is entered into by and between VG Life Sciences Inc. (formerly Viral Genetics, Inc.) a Delaware corporation
with its executive office located at 2290 Huntington Drive, Suite 100, San Marino, California 91108 (the &ldquo;<U>Company</U>&rdquo;),
and JTL Enterprises Corp, a New York corporation with its executive offices located at 1107 38th Avenue, Seattle, WA 98122 (&ldquo;<U>Consultant</U>&rdquo;).
The terms &ldquo;<U>Party</U>&rdquo; and &ldquo;<U>Parties</U>&rdquo; refer to the Company, VG Energy, Inc. and Consultant individually
and collectively.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Whereas
the Parties have agreed to certain modifications with respect to compensation arrangements to be effective on
commencement of this agreement; and</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Whereas
it is the intention of the Parties that all the terms and conditions included in the Consulting Agreement to which
this addendum shall be attached shall apply to this Addendum as if it were part of the agreement, unless specifically
modified below.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Therefore
the parties hereto for good and valuable consideration agree to the following modifications to the original paragraphs:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">2.
<U>Fees and Expenses</U>. Attachment A Modified, which is incorporated herein, is a summary of these fees which shall be earned
monthly as indicated for each of the 12 months in the period ending December 31, 2012, payable in cash and shares of common stock
of the Company and VG Energy. Consultant shall earn and be fully vested in all fees and common shares as services are billed and
rendered monthly. Shares of VGLS have been determined utilitizing a price of $0.20 per share of VGLS after giving effect to the
6600:1 reverse split and $0.83 per share of VG Energy.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Consultant
may elect, at Consultant&rsquo;s sole option, to accept restricted shares of the Company and/or VG Energy and common
stock purchase warrants in lieu of cash payments based upon a terms and conditions agreed to by the parties hereto. In that
event, the Company shall cause certificates and appropriate warrants to be issued within 10 days of notice by Consultant
of conversion of delinquent payments.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">The
Company acknowledges that it is indebted to Consultant for fees related to Services rendered in 2011 pursuant to
the proceeding Consulting Services Agreement dated February 9, 2011 and amended June 30, 2011 in the amoun t of $13,750.
Further, all cash compensation and stock based compensation for services pursuant to this agreement are currently due
and payable.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><B>IN
WITNESS WHEREOF</B>, and intending to be legally bound, this Addendum shall be considered as part of the Consulting
Agreement between the parties which was effective as of January 1, 2012, an executed copy of which is attached, has been
executed by the Company and Consultant effective as of the date first written above.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">VG
Life Sciences Inc. (formerly Viral Genetics, Inc.)</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">By:

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Name
and Title: Haig Keledjian, President</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in; color: #777777; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
